text: As the Toronto Transit Commission operates a transit service on Yonge Street, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is recommending that a 10 minute maximum parking limit be authorized from 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., daily, on the west side of Yonge Street, between a point 25 metres south of Montgomery Avenue and a point 13 metres further south. There was a CurbTO Temporary Parking Pick-Up Zone in this area until recently and now parking is prohibited at all times. The proposed amendments will provide short-term parking for customers of nearby businesses, similar to when there was a CurbTO Temporary Parking Pick-Up Zone designated.

City Council on February 7 and 8, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit parking at all times on the west side of Yonge Street, between Montgomery Avenue and a point 25 metres south. 2. City Council authorize parking for a maximum period of 10 minutes, from 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily, on the west side of Yonge Street, between a point 25 metres south of Montgomery Avenue and a point 13 metres further south.
